title: Just For Laughs
description:
JustForLaughs Comedy, the official YouTube Channel of the Just For Laughs Comedy Festival. What's Just For Laughs? Oh, just the biggest, funniest, most awesomest comedy festival in the whole world. No big deal. We specialize in brilliant, hilarious, original, smart, edgy stand-up, sketch, and improv.

Just For Laughs is the world’s premiere destination for stand-up comedy. Founded in 1983, JFL produces the world’s largest and most prestigious comedy event every July in Montreal, as well as annual festivals in Toronto and Sydney. On this channel, you will find comedic clips from some of the most legendary comedians in the business: Chris Rock, Bill Burr, Kevin Hart, John Mulaney, Bo Burnham, Amy Schumer and many many more. If you just want to laugh, you’re in the right place.

The special was produced by Jane Churchill-Smith of Just for Laughs and shot by the same all-Canadian camera team that shot last year’s hit, Nirvana The Band The Show The Movie, led by cinematographer Nikolay Michaylov (Matt and Mara) and with help from Jared Raab (BlackBerry), Luca Tarantini, and Suave Hupa. The edit was done by Reuter and Shaliek Jenkins, who have worked on many popular stand up specials of the last ten years. Sound was done by Kevvy Maher.
